name: go-libp2p-kad-dht-awaitable-provide-operations
instr:
go-libp2p-kad-dht cannot currently expose eventual local and peer-delivery results for provider announcements across root, FullRT, and Dual routing. Add an awaitable operation that starts immediately without changing the wire protocol or `Provide` behavior or return boundaries.

Keep operations live until all selected work settles, beyond optimistic and FullRT early-return thresholds. Report each selected peer once, in peer-identity order. Make snapshots immutable and concurrency-safe, with counts advancing monotonically to one stable terminal report. Cancellation must be idempotent, prevent unscheduled work, preserve completed outcomes, distinguish cancelled deliveries from transport failures, and release every waiter. Preserve finished sends after optimistic return and settle outstanding transport work once, including during closure.

Report local persistence independently as `LocalStoreOutcome(Attempted, Stored, Err)` and peer transport as `PeerDelivery(Peer, Outcome, Err)`. Successful delivery does not imply remote persistence. Root classic announcements must preserve distance-selected targets and report one terminal delivery outcome per attempted ADD_PROVIDER send. If lookup ends at the reserved deadline, include only targets selected before final fanout.

FullRT must account for skipped and parallel work. Slow workers may continue after its success threshold, but final reports cover every selected target. Dual must attribute work only to the selected `ProvideNetworkWAN`
